inj.note: The Ravens are seemingly being careful with Fagnano's injured ankle, but he was able to get out there Tuesday -- two days prior to his team's Week 9 matchup with the Jaguars. With Lamar Jackson (thumb) headed to injured reserve and Tyler Huntley (toe) unlikely to go Thursday, the banged-up Fagnano is the favorite to start for Baltimore in Week 9.

news.h: Ravens QB Joe Fagnano (ankle) has chance to play Thursday
news.d: Ravens quarterback Joe Fagnano is dealing with an ankle injury but has "a chance" to play Thursday night, coach Jesse Minter said.
